name: The Rubens at the Palace
insider_take: Royal luxury meets British elegance just steps from Buckingham Palace's gates.
whats_special: The Rubens holds the unique distinction of being the only hotel directly overlooking the Royal Mews, where you can watch the Queen's horses and carriages from your window. Built in 1912, this historic property features an award-winning afternoon tea service and the UK's largest collection of Spy novels in their library. The hotel's Royal Rooms offer unparalleled views of the palace grounds and ceremonies.
pro_tip: Book a Palace View room during Changing of the Guard days (Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday) for front-row seats to this iconic ceremony without the crowds below.
dont_miss: The traditional afternoon tea in the Palace Lounge, featuring homemade scones and finger sandwiches while watching royal activity unfold outside. Visit the hotel's historic Cavalry Bar, adorned with military memorabilia, and take advantage of being within walking distance of Westminster Abbey, Big Ben, and St. James's Park.
pros: Prime location directly opposite Buckingham Palace
Traditional British luxury with Victorian elegance
Outstanding personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Historic building with traditional room layouts
